purpose: Teach: 手がかり/恐れる/惜しま/誇っ/心地よく/震える/諦める/寄席

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃の手がかり写真、整理しよう。
lines.en: Let's organize those old photographs from when we were young.
lines.style: Gentle proposition, a touch of nostalgia in the breath. Measured pace, settling into the memory. Not urgent—inviting her to join him in the sorting.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。地震を恐れる時代、お互い乗り越えたわね。
lines.en: Yes. We got through that earthquake-scared time together, didn't we?
lines.style: Warm affirmation with quiet pride underneath. Slight pause before 'together'—letting the weight of the years sit there. Soft, intimate tone, like she's speaking into a memory they both hold.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 時間を惜しまずに、子育てしたな。
lines.en: We didn't hesitate to pour everything into raising the children.
lines.style: Wistful, looking back. Voice softens on 'everything.' A slight exhale—not regret, but the weight of time recognizing what was given. Slow, deliberate delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫を誇っている、いい子に育って。
lines.en: I'm so proud of our grandchildren—they turned out to be good people.
lines.style: Tender conviction. Voice brightens slightly on 'proud.' A mother's and grandmother's certainty—not boasting, just stating something true. Warm close to the statement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 庭の風、心地よく感じるな。
lines.en: The breeze in the garden feels lovely today.
lines.style: Soft observation, almost to himself. Gentle inhale on the opening. Voice trails with contentment. The kind of quiet appreciation that doesn't need agreement, just acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 手、最近、ちょっと震える時があるの。
lines.en: My hands have been shaking a bit lately, you know.
lines.style: Quiet admission, not complaining. Slight hesitation before speaking—testing whether to say it at all. Vulnerable but matter-of-fact. Voice remains steady even as she describes the tremor.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: まだまだ、諦めるのは早いぞ。
lines.en: But we're not ready to give up yet.
lines.style: Quiet firmness. Lean into the conviction on 'not.' Reassurance without being overconfident. The voice of someone who knows what it means to endure. Steady, grounding.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 寄席、若い頃よく行ったわね、二人で。
lines.en: We used to go to the storytelling shows so often when we were younger, remember? The two of us.
lines.style: Nostalgic warmth with a smile in the voice. Slight lift on 'remember'—inviting him into the shared memory. Pace slows on 'the two of us'—letting that intimacy linger.
